metadata.title: Cliopatria v0.2.1 — European detailed display with sourced Iceland correction
metadata.dateSemantics: fromYear <= selectedYear <= toYear (inclusive); source intervals are approximate historical reconstructions, not annual measurements
metadata.geometryEdits: Regenerated from the original source records, clipped to the declared bbox with the west edge extended to -25 degrees to retain Iceland; only the existing sourceRecords are included; make_valid where required; topology-preserving Douglas–Peucker simplification at 0.007 degrees; valid-output coordinate grid 0.00001 degrees; standard GeoJSON orientation. Overview semantic properties, identifiers and coalesced intervals retained. Where finer geometry differs inside an overview interval, geometryVariants preserves the original source intervals. No geometry invented or interpolated. Iceland-only editorial display correction: upstream shapes are excised inside the isolated Iceland envelope, then replaced by dated Natural Earth island masks; see icelandCorrection.
metadata.license: Cliopatria portions: CC BY 4.0; Natural Earth masks: public domain; editorial compilation: GPL-3.0-only
metadata.citation: Bennett, J. S., Mutch, E., Tollefson, A., et al. (2025). Cliopatria – A geospatial database of world-wide political entities from 3400BCE to 2024CE. Scientific Data 12, 247.
metadata.modernBoundaryNote: Modern outlines reproduce the source dataset’s historical reconstruction. They do not adjudicate disputed sovereignty, international recognition, or present-day borders. Source coverage ends in 2024.
metadata.geometryVariantsSemantics: For a selected year, use the geometry of the unique geometryVariants segment whose fromYear <= year <= toYear. If geometryVariants is absent, use feature.geometry. Top-level properties and recordId remain identical to the overview file.
metadata.historicalInterpretation: Increased geometric detail retains more of the same academic reconstruction; it does not establish additional historical certainty or settlement-scale boundary accuracy.
metadata.upstreamGeometryEdits: Regenerated from the original source records, clipped to the declared bbox with the west edge extended to -25 degrees to retain Iceland; only the existing sourceRecords are included; make_valid where required; topology-preserving Douglas–Peucker simplification at 0.007 degrees; valid-output coordinate grid 0.00001 degrees; standard GeoJSON orientation. Overview semantic properties, identifiers and coalesced intervals retained. Where finer geometry differs inside an overview interval, geometryVariants preserves the original source intervals. No geometry invented or interpolated.

icelandCorrection.annualConvention: An annual display uses the status in force by the end of that year. Dates below preserve the event's actual precision; 1262–1263 is an explicitly transitional display, not a reconstructed internal partition.
icelandCorrection.geometryConvention: Natural Earth 1:10m modern Iceland land is an island display mask. It is not a reconstruction of medieval shorelines, settlement extent, maritime limits or internal administration. The excision rectangle isolates Iceland from all other land in the supplied Natural Earth source, and removes upstream coastal misalignment fragments before replacement.
icelandCorrection.before930: Remove upstream political fills inside the excision envelope and draw no replacement state fill. This makes no claim that Iceland was uninhabited or that settlements formed one sovereign state.
icelandCorrection.license: Natural Earth geometry: public domain; project editorial compilation and script: GPL-3.0-only
